commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
refactor: centralize gRPC exception handling

- Remove try-catch blocks from MovieGrpcService and MovieServiceGrpcClient
- Add MovieGrpcExceptionHandler for centralized Status exception mapping
- Configure named gRPC client channel with GrpcClientsConfig
- Rename default channel to named "movie" channel in application properties
- Update MovieGrpcServiceTest to expect exceptions directly

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
refactor: migrate from net.devh to Spring gRPC

- Removed movie-grpc-lib module, embedding proto definitions directly in each app module
- Replaced net.devh gRPC starter with org.springframework.grpc (Spring gRPC)
- Updated client to use constructor injection instead of @GrpcClient
- Moved proto files into movie-grpc-server and movie-grpc-client
- Switched config to spring.grpc.client namespace
- Added protobuf-maven-plugin for code generation in both modules
- Updated imports, package names, and README

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
style: format code with google-java-format and enforce via Spotless

- Apply Google Java Format (GOOGLE style) across all Java files
- Configure Spotless Maven plugin in parent POM to enforce formatting
- Add Spotless check to the validate phase of the build
- Update README with code formatting instructions
- Reorganize import order to comply with style rules
- Fix missing newlines at end of several source files
- Make movie-grpc-lib inherit from parent POM

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
docs: add license, funding, and architecture docs

- Add MIT License file to the repository
- Add Buy Me A Coffee funding link to FUNDING.yml
- Add architecture diagram, badges, support, and license sections to README

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
test: add unit tests for server and client modules

- Add MovieServiceTest, MovieGrpcServiceTest, MovieMapperTest for server module
- Add MovieServiceGrpcClientTest, MovieResponseTest, MoviesCommandsTest for client module
- Remove disabled placeholder application context tests
- Add test instructions to README

commits.author: ivangfr
commits.message:
refactor: upgrade to Spring Boot 4.0.7 and Java 25

- Update parent POM to Spring Boot 4.0.7 and Java 25
- Migrate Spring Shell 4 API: replace @ShellMethod/@ShellComponent with @Command/@Component
- Add jansi starter for Spring Shell 4 terminal support
- Upgrade gRPC to 1.83.0 and protobuf to 3.25.9
- Extract MovieMapper class for proto-domain mapping
- Add MovieAlreadyExistsException and validation in MovieService
- Add error handling with StatusRuntimeException in gRPC client and server
- Replace offset/page with page parameter in pagination requests
- Use protobuf optional fields for UpdateMovieRequest
- Remove spring-boot-starter-web dependency from server
- Update README with Java 25, PostgreSQL 18.4, and simplified instructions
